drivers: Three simultaneous attributes (shape, fill, rotation) with distribution-of-three rules for shape and fill plus a +45° rotation progression within rows
Distribution rules narrow options to two (A vs D); final discrimination relies only on reading the rotation progression 180→225→270
Rotation of arrows is visually easy to judge, and 90 s is ample for a 3-rule matrix
Constant count of 5 is a non-informative feature that may distract some low-ability respondents
